subject: dsa
title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
summary: Split into two equal halves only if some subset sums to half the total. dp[s] is true when sum s is reachable; each number unlocks new sums.
problem: Given an array of positive integers, decide whether it can be split into two subsets with equal sums.

steps.caption: The total is 10, so each side must sum to 5. Reduce it to one question: can a subset sum to exactly 5? dp[s] means sum s is reachable.
Base case: dp[0] = T, since the empty subset sums to 0. Every reachable sum builds from here.
Use number 1. Sum 1 becomes reachable as 0 + 1, so dp[1] flips to T.
Use number 2. Sums 2 (0+2) and 3 (1+2) become reachable.
Use number 3. Sums 4 (1+3) and 5 (2+3) become reachable, and 5 is our target.
dp[5] = T, so a subset sums to 5 and we never even need the 4. The array splits into {1,4} and {2,3}.
